05-22-1314 is May 22, 1314.  
336 days later:  
From May 22, 1314 to May 22, 1315 is 365 days (1315 is not a leap year).  
336 days is 29 days short of 365 days, so go back 29 days from May 22, 1315.  
May 22 → April 22 is 30 days back, so April 23 is 29 days before May 22.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1315-04-23
